title: Trade Alpha Attribution - Trade vs BuyHold vs uquant Capability Comparison

comparison_contract.trade_vs_buy_hold: matched current 17, window, initial capital and Trade cost assumptions
comparison_contract.trade_vs_uquant: structural only; universes/windows/contracts are not matched, so absolute wealth is not ranked or treated as causal evidence

trade_vs_buy_hold.conclusion: Trade outperforms this matched Buy & Hold path while experiencing shallower maximum drawdown. The research target is remaining upside loss inside Trade, not catching up to Buy & Hold.

uquant_own_system_evidence.warning: These are uquant's own-system figures and are not directly comparable to Trade's different production contract.

uquant_mechanism_observations: soft exits that can retain residual strategic shares
trade_mechanism_observations: fine-grained account-risk budgeting and portfolio execution coordination
strong risk-event observability and execution constraints

evidence_supported_relative_gap_hypothes.basis: strong post-buy returns plus strong post-sell returns and frequent re-entry
67 of 109 sell buckets re-enter within 60 sessions
post-buy forward-return quality is already strong
positive realized PnL is highly concentrated, but matched causal concentration replay was not performed

next_research: Use a Trade-native winner-lifecycle / AB5-efficiency contract. Borrow no uquant production rules directly; first test whether Trade can reduce avoidable intervention on confirmed winners while retaining its risk advantage.
limitation: Do not quantify how much of any Trade-uquant return gap comes from entry timing, holding duration or concentration until both systems are replayed under a matched universe/window/capital/cost contract.
